title: Visualizing stress granule dynamics with an RNA guanine quadruplex targeted ruthenium(II) peptide conjugate
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1403-1413
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00008D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rhianne C. Curley, Lorcan Holden, Tia E. Keyes
A cell permeable Ru(II) polypyridyl complex conjugated to G4 binding domain peptide from RNA helicase associated with AU-rich element (RHAU) was developed as a tool to visualize stress granule dynamics in live cells.
